title: Coleslaw With Asian Flavors
description: This is a terrific fresh, crunchy Asian Slaw with shredded vegetables like traditional Coleslaw. The fresh herbs and Asian Dressing infused with Thai flavours makes this extra special. A light, healthy, crunchy Asian salad that is a great side for all types of Asian foods. Dressing is a great salty / sour / spicy lime dressing reminiscent of Thai and Vietnamese food. Make a big batch because it keeps for days. Add chicken if making this as a meal.
servings: 8 to 10 as a side, 4 as a meal with chicken
ingredients: 3 cups green cabbage or Chinese cabbage , shredded
3 green onions , finely sliced on the diagonal
1/4 cup Asian Fried Shallots (or fried onions from the store)
3 tbsp rice vinegar (or cider of white wine vinegar)
2 tsp fish sauce, optional or more soy sauce
2 tbsp lime juice, or more rice rinegar
3 tbsp peanut oil, or other neutral oil
1/2 tsp birds eye or other red chilli , finely diced (optional)
directions: Combine the dressing ingredients in a jar and shake well.
Combine the salad ingredients, except the Asian Fried Shallots.
Pour over dressing and toss to combine.
Garnish with Asian Fried Shallots. Serve!
